notes: Appends a <style> or <link rel=stylesheet> from the main world of the iframe's current document, so its CSP applies, and waits for the element's load. Returns a scoped JSHandle of the element, not an ElementHandle; a CSP refusal fails with RefusedByPolicy and a URL that doesn't load with ResourceFailed.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.
